studio.title: Production Studio
studio.shareScreeningDescription: Anyone with this link can view your Screening Room presentation. They won't need a Sceneflow account.
studio.shareBulletView: Viewers can watch with full audio and translations
studio.shareBulletNoEdit: They cannot edit or download your project
studio.shareBulletDisable: You can disable this link anytime
studio.deleteCharacterDescription: The character "{name}" has {count, plural, one {# dialogue line} other {# dialogue lines}} in the script. What would you like to do with these dialogue lines?
studio.clearCharacterIdsHint: Remove character IDs from dialogue lines. The dialogue will match characters by name using the improved fallback matching.
studio.reassignToAnotherHint: Assign all dialogue lines to a different character.
studio.mergeDuplicatesDescription: Select which character to keep and which duplicates to merge into it.
studio.mergeDialogueNote: All dialogue lines from duplicate characters will be assigned to the primary character.
studio.importTranslationDescription: Paste your translated script below. The format should match the exported format:
studio.deleteBeatDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this segment? This action cannot be undone.
studio.deleteSceneDescription: This will permanently remove this scene and all associated assets.

script.heading: Scene heading
script.noScriptHint: Generate a script from your approved blueprint to start production.

language.languageHint: Dialogue and narration are generated in this language. Frame and video prompts stay in English.

prompts.englishOnlyNotice: Prompts stay in English: image and video models produce noticeably weaker results from translated prompts.

express.title: Express All Scenes (advanced)
express.description: Runs Direction → Audio → pre-vis frames for every scene in parallel (up to 3 at a time). This is a long, credit-heavy run — per-scene Express on each scene card is recommended for checkpoints.
express.audioLanguageHint: Dialogue and narration will be generated in {lang}. Existing audio in other languages is left untouched.
express.storyboardQualityDraftHint: Generates fast layout frames for review. Use Finalize frames afterward for hi-res photorealistic animatic and video generation.
express.soundEffectsHint: Sound effects are included in Veo video segments during production. Animatic preview uses narration, dialogue, and optional music only.
express.onlyMissingFramesHint: Skip frames that already have images.
express.regenerateExistingHint: Recompute every phase even if direction, audio, or image is already present.
express.artStyleLockedHint: Locked in Blueprint — change foundation there to reimagine.
express.artStyleUnlockedHint: Applied to all pre-vis frames and flows through video generation.
express.costEstimateDisclaimer: Estimates only. Actual usage depends on dialogue length and the number of phases that actually need to run.

expressAudio.title: Express Audio
expressAudio.description: Generate dialogue, sound effects, and music for this scene concurrently. Dialogue uses TTS, action beats use Veo native audio, and music uses Lyria.
expressAudio.scopeAllWarning: Existing audio for the selected items will be deleted and regenerated.
expressAudio.noAudioItems: No audio items available for this scene.

expressSfx.title: Express Veo SFX
expressSfx.description: Generate action-beat sound effects concurrently (up to 2 at a time). Each beat uses Veo native audio, then extracts MP3 for the animatic.
expressSfx.regenerateWithAudio: Regenerate beats that already have audio

expressScene.title: Express Scene
expressScene.description: Choose which pre-vis frames to generate or regenerate. Regenerating existing frames updates images only — direction and audio are left unchanged.
expressScene.scopeRegenerateHint: Checked frames with existing images will be regenerated. Direction and audio are not rerun.
expressScene.noFrames: No frames available for this scope.
expressScene.imageCredits: Image credits (est.): {credits} ({count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}} × {perFrame})

expressGenerateAll.title: Generate All
expressGenerateAll.description: Run Express Audio and Express Scene frames in parallel. Defaults match each pipeline’s “missing only” selection — adjust scope if you need to regenerate.
expressGenerateAll.noAudioItems: No audio items for this scene.
expressGenerateAll.imageCredits: Image credits (est.): {credits} ({count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}} × {perFrame})

retake.title: Replace existing take?
retake.description: This beat already has a generated video. Opening the generator or uploading will add a new take and may consume credits.

reset.title: Reset scene production?
reset.warning: This removes your entire <bold>beat timeline</bold> for this scene and cannot be undone. You will need to run segment setup again from scratch.
reset.segmentDetail: Timing, direction notes, Veo prompts, and dialogue-to-segment mapping
reset.keyframeImage: {count, plural, one {# keyframe image} other {# keyframe images}}
reset.keyframeDetailAcross: Across {count, plural, one {# segment} other {# segments}} (start/end frames)
reset.keyframeDetailDefault: Start and end frame stills used for video generation
reset.videoClip: {count, plural, one {# generated video clip} other {# generated video clips}}
reset.videoDetail: Beat-level Veo / I2V outputs and active takes on the timeline
reset.imageClip: {count, plural, one {# image clip} other {# image clips}}
reset.imageClipDetail: Uploaded or generated still assets attached to segments
reset.alternateTake: {count, plural, one {# alternate take} other {# alternate takes}}
reset.sceneRenderStreams: {count, plural, one {# language or output stream} other {# language or output streams}} linked to this scene
reset.sceneRenderDefault: Final mixed scene output from the production mixer
reset.beatStructureDetail: No keyframes or clips detected yet, but segmentation progress will still be cleared
reset.notDeleted: <bold>Not deleted:</bold> script text, scene dialogue, narration, music/SFX audio, scene still image, and character references.

screening.generateStreamDescription: Translate scene text and generate dialogue/narration audio for this language. Existing music and sound effects will be reused.
screening.publishRevisionDescription: Increments the version (e.g. v{current} → v{next}). Your share link does not change. Reviewers who refresh will see the new current version; their next submissions are stamped accordingly.
screening.changeNotesPlaceholder: What changed since the last version?

segments.addDescription: Create a new visual segment to extend the scene timeline.
segments.editDescription: Modify the segment's prompt, duration, and generation settings.
segments.hasFramesWarning: This segment has generated frames that will be lost.
segments.lastBeatWarning: Warning: This is the only segment in the scene. Deleting it will leave the scene without any keyframes.
segments.shiftWarning: Deleting this segment will shift all subsequent segments. Timing and sequence indices will be automatically recalculated.
segments.regenerateDescription: Clear all segments and return to the Beat Builder to start fresh.
segments.regenerateAssetsWarning: Warning: This will delete all segments including generated keyframes and video assets. This action cannot be undone.
segments.regenerateEmptyWarning: All current segments will be removed. You'll be taken to the Beat Builder to configure and regenerate with new settings.
segments.regenerateNextHint: The Beat Builder will open with controls for total duration, segment count, focus mode, and custom direction.
segments.generateDescription: Configure how segments are created for this scene.
segments.narrationDrivenHint: Create segments that align with and illustrate the narration. Each segment becomes a cinematic backdrop for the voiceover.
segments.addTypeDescription: Choose a segment purpose to insert into the timeline.

audio.assetsDescription: Manage audio tracks for this scene. Add, remove, or re-sync audio clips from the script.
audio.alignmentDescription: Align this segment with dialogue and audio tracks for precise timing.
audio.generateDescription: Select asset types to generate for all scenes
audio.translateBeforeAudio: Text will be translated from English to {language} before generating audio

export.title: Export Document
export.streamDescription: Scene {number} — Fast (WebM) for drafts, Broadcast (MP4) for delivery, or Cloud for long scenes.

promptDirection.title: Prompt Direction
promptDirection.description: Review and refine the prompt that will guide video generation.
promptDirection.refineHint: Describe how you'd like to modify the prompt in natural language.
promptDirection.refinePlaceholder: e.g., Make it more dramatic, slow down the motion...

FRAME_TO_VIDEO.tip1: Focus on motion and transitions between frames
FRAME_TO_VIDEO.tip2: Avoid camera movements that deviate from the end frame
FRAME_TO_VIDEO.tip3: Describe how elements transform from start to end

IMAGE_TO_VIDEO.tip1: Describe how the static image should come to life
IMAGE_TO_VIDEO.tip2: Include subtle movements like breathing, blinking
IMAGE_TO_VIDEO.tip3: Maintain consistency with the starting image

TEXT_TO_VIDEO.tip1: Be specific about visual details and composition

EXTEND.tip1: Focus on continuation of existing motion
EXTEND.tip2: Maintain visual continuity with source video
EXTEND.tip3: Describe what happens next in the scene

REFERENCE_IMAGES.tip1: Use reference images for character consistency
REFERENCE_IMAGES.tip2: Describe scene while referencing character styles
REFERENCE_IMAGES.tip3: Combine visual references with scene description

IMAGE_TO_VIDEO.example1: Add wind effects to hair and clothes

EXTEND.example3: Increase the energy of the scene

director.title: Director Console
director.description: Configure generation settings before rendering video segments.

framePrompt.title: Frame Prompt
framePrompt.description: Review and edit the prompt used to generate this frame.

foundation.changeArtStyleDescription: Changing your art style requires a Blueprint reimagine. SceneFlow will optimize your script for the new aesthetic.
foundation.changeAspectRatioDescription: Changing aspect ratio requires a Blueprint reimagine. Scene directions and framing will be rebuilt for the new format.
foundation.loseEditsTitle: You will lose manual Production edits:
foundation.loseScriptTweaks: Script line tweaks not yet locked

retakeExtra.intelligentDescription: Describe the correction. We will route a frame edit, prompt rewrite, or both.
retakeExtra.fixPlaceholder: Describe what to fix, e.g. 'remove the coffee cup on the table'
retakeExtra.fixStartingFrameHint: Edit the frame-locked start image before regenerating.
retakeExtra.applyPromptChangesHint: Use the revised prompt and negative additions.
retakeExtra.keyframeRegenDescription: Rebuild start and end frames for this beat with updated direction.
